text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. The GII Yayoi Sho, is it? Seems like 
quite a decent lineup has gathered.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but... It's still a bit lacking to 
gather sufficient data."

A sudden pang of unease strikes me at 
Agnes Tachyon's words.
choice_data_list: You're going to run properly, right...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course. This race leads into the 
Satsuki Sho. We shouldn't narrow down our 
options.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if it's not a GⅠ, it's not a 
race you can afford to take lightly.
